build.note: In-game measurement; no source bytes were read. Related leads, not re-opened by this receipt: L120 and L124 (StanceChangePenalties) and L108 (MountedPlus recoil).

question: How much does the ADS red-dot sway of the M433 with the Mini Flex sight differ between standing, crouched, prone, crouch-mounted and prone-mounted, with and without a (undeployed) bipod, and does mounting remove the sway?

sourceFacts.recordings: Operator recordings reference-data/Recordings/10262026/Stance Sway/M433_MiniFlex_<grip>_<stance>.mp4: firing range, ADS, not firing, 2560x1440 at 60 fps, about 11 s each. M433 with the Mini Flex sight; grip None (no bottom-rail attachment) or Bipod. Stances Standing, Crouched, Prone, CrouchMounted (rested on the range counter) and ProneMounted (bipod only: the game offers no prone mount without one). The None and Bipod clips of each stance were taken from the same position. The videos are kept locally only; the evidence sheet is in the site repo.
sourceFacts.method: scripts/stance-sway-track.py (site repo). The first 2 s of each clip are skipped; about 9 s are measured. Units are pixels of the 2560x1440 frame; the ADS camera scale is not calibrated. Aim sway = the red dot's movement against the scene (dot screen position minus scene shift).

table.unit: total horizontal x vertical range in px (RMS radius about the clip mean)

points: Unmounted: the scene (camera) moves about 5 x 7 px, the red dot a further 2.5 to 3.5 x 4 to 5 px on screen, and the weapon model stays fixed on screen (under 0.2 px).

Vertical sway repeats about every 3 s (three cycles per clip), so the vertical range is complete; the horizontal drift is slower than the clip (one or two zero crossings), so the horizontal ranges are partial swings and only show the stances are similar.
Mounted, with or without the bipod: scene, weapon and dot do not move; phase-correlation peaks are 0.96 to 0.97 against 0.40 to 0.44 in the unmounted clips.
The red dot was found in 50 of 592 ProneMounted frames and 373 of 535 None_Crouched frames; the mounted result does not depend on it.
sourceFacts.notCovered: Other weapons and magnified optics (the type list has GunSwayStanceZoomModifierData), and the sway penalty for changing stance while aiming (GunSwayStanceChangePenalty).

inference: Standing, crouched and prone sway the same on this weapon and sight (ranges within the noise of a 9 s window).
A fitted but undeployed bipod changes nothing.
Mounting removes all weapon and camera sway, with or without a bipod or grip pod; the bipod's only part is allowing a prone mount (the note's reading).
unresolved: Other weapons and magnified optics were not measured, and the stance-change sway penalty was not tested.
Horizontal ranges are partial swings (the drift is slower than the clip), so only the vertical range is complete.
The ADS camera scale is not calibrated, so the pixel ranges are not degrees; no source value was read, so no source operand is tied to this measurement.
